title: Human in the loop: grading is a queue, not a hunt

cards.title: A person's yes, made cheap and exact
cards.text: Where a person decides, the screen asks once, shows what will happen, and makes the answer one action.

cards.title: Grading as a queue
cards.text: One answer at a time on /admin/review, keys 1, 2 and 3, a count that falls, still blind.

cards.title: The preview is the check
cards.text: An upload says what saving would change, and Save writes exactly that.

cards.title: The click is the yes
cards.text: A ticket marked Not sent yet, cards to choose from, and a form for what only the visitor knows.
